comment: The standing typecheck findings, per config. `scripts/precommit.mjs` fails
when a count goes ABOVE one of these and tells you to lower it when a count
comes in below — a backlog that only ever ratchets down.
Lower these in the same commit that removes the findings. Raising one is a
deliberate act and should be explained in the commit message; if it needs
raising to get a change in, the change has added type errors.
